domains.role: application, direct UI, touch, encoder, maximum legal QSPI display path, analog-video capture and native 2.4-GHz Wi-Fi/BLE
three fully concurrent nRF24 paths, CC1101, independent VHF/UHF voice radios and U214/LoRa Cap
dedicated high-speed fan-out for C5, RF RP, microSD, audio, FM/AM/SW/LW plus converted Airband receiver and generic M5 Unit port
cell admission, pack diagnostics and protected shutdown
independent watchdog, thermal supervision, TX lease/evidence and FAULT_KILL

transports.reason: Carries control and selected data only; display and analog video never traverse IPC.

transports.service_mux: C5 GPIO13/14 are switched between SDIO D3/D2 and the independent service USB connector; service mode stops and resets the runtime link before switching.

transports.reason: The worst accepted simultaneous three-nRF/CC payload remains below this floor and never shares its peripheral with storage or C5.
The existing accepted recording requirement is met without using the S3 display peripheral or crossing S3_HUB for local captures.
Carries Pack read-only state and Safety heartbeat/lease/fault mailboxes; local Safety hardware still owns watchdog service and asynchronous FAULT_KILL.

s3_pin_map.gate: decoder data output must be high-Z through strap sampling
hub held reset/high-Z through strap sampling
only bounded internal UI/power/safety open-drain sources; external Unit and RF control are excluded
external pull preserves the accepted strap

hub_pin_groups.role: dedicated SPI plus ALERT to RF RP
Hub-local I2C for codec, Si4732, headset, video decoder and slow controls
dedicated microSD SPI SCK/MOSI/MISO/CS plus power and detect
FPV RSSI ADC, receiver power and lock/evidence
receiver channel-control reserve for the selected exact serial module
AIR_RX_EN fail-low switched-domain and LT5560 enable control
AIR_RX_MODE direct-FM/SW versus converted-Airband RF selector; reset default is direct FM/SW
dedicated fail-closed I2C controller bus to Pack and Safety MSPM0 mailboxes

display.interface: dedicated direct QSPI on S3 SPI2 with GDMA and TE
display.s3_supported_sources: ESP32-S3 GPSPI uses APB 80 MHz or XTAL 40 MHz in the locked ESP-IDF. The fastest normal divided clock not exceeding 62.5 MHz is therefore 40 MHz; 80 MHz would violate the panel timing.
display.video_window: 320x240 RGB565 at 30 fps is 4.608 MB/s and 23.04% of the selected QSPI payload
display.maximality_result: 40 MHz is the maximum datasheet-legal clock obtainable from the supported S3 GPSPI sources without panel overclocking. Parallel i8080 is rejected in R2 because it would consume the shared LCD_CAM camera resource needed by direct analog video capture.
display.hil: Route and tune for the 40-MHz guaranteed mode; measure edges, TE scheduling, full-frame and dirty-region latency under simultaneous camera DMA before accepting any non-standard clock experiment.

fpv.rf: replaceable exact serial analog 5.8-GHz receiver module; generic RX5808 is evidence input, not an accepted MPN
fpv.external_connector: MMCX, DC to at least 6 GHz, user-facing and labelled FPV RX 5.8G
fpv.decoder: Texas Instruments TVP5150AM1PBS or industrial-temperature TVP5150AM1IPBS after factory-route confirmation
fpv.capture: 8-bit BT.601/BT.656-compatible YUV422 plus PCLK/VSYNC/HREF into S3 LCD_CAM and GDMA; hardware YUV422-to-RGB565 conversion is required
fpv.first_acceptance_mode: NTSC/PAL source to centered 320x240 live view at source frame rate with UI overlay/remaining portrait area; uncompressed full-source recording is not promised
fpv.coexistence: Entering FPV mode powers the receiver/decoder group, disables C5 5-GHz RF and all unused transmit groups, and preserves the one-active-signal-group rule.
fpv.power_thermal_gate: Receiver, decoder, regulator and local shielding are added to the unattended thermal and battery budgets before H1 acceptance.

airband.signal_group: BROADCAST_RX remains the exclusive top-level receive group; FM, SW, AM/LW and AIR are mutually exclusive submodes
airband.i2c: SI5351A-B-GTR joins the isolated Hub-local I2C bus at address 0x60; it does not share S3 UI I2C
airband.gp41: AIR_RX_EN is pulled low and removes the Airband RF/LO domain when unused
airband.gp42: AIR_RX_MODE defaults to the direct FM/SW path before Hub firmware starts

power.r1_status: The reviewed R1 2.493-A worst state and 2.5-A continuous rail are historical only because R2 adds an always-present Hub RP plus FPV and Airband domains.

airband_increment.rail: switched low-noise 3.0-V RF domain plus Hub-local 3.3-V control
airband_increment.basis: PGA-103+ 60 mA at 3 V; LT5560 up to 12 mA at 3 V; SI5351 core plus one output up to 40.6 mA; selector/control/filter margin included

power.coexistence: FPV and Airband are never powered together; both remain mutually exclusive with unused transmit groups under the one-active-signal-group rule.

h1_required_envelope.action: recalculate the complete six-domain rail/state matrix and requalify the buck, eFuse threshold, inductor, copper and thermal path before retaining or replacing the R1 parts

firmware_rebaseline.r1_status: F0-F4 R1 artifacts remain regression evidence but no longer describe the physical topology.
required_work: replace direct S3-C5 and S3-RF links with S3-Hub, Hub-C5 and Hub-RF transports
route Pack status and Safety heartbeat/lease/fault mailboxes through the dedicated Hub GP43/44 I2C bus without weakening local watchdog or FAULT_KILL ownership
move storage, audio and BROADCAST_RX ownership from S3 to Hub RP
add fail-low Airband mode control, Si5351 setup, scan/record and ACARS receive pipeline
preserve direct S3 UI/display/FPV scheduling and all existing safety/quiet-state semantics
regenerate six-target build, memory, update, emulator/dev-board and HIL matrices before resuming F4
